chapter_seo_title: Han Li vs Giant Mantis – The Real Treasure Is a Jade Slip
chapter_meta_description: Han Li uses the Reversed Five Elements Formation to kill a giant mantis, but the real prize is a Core Formation cultivator’s storage pouch—and a jade slip full of strange insect secrets.
og_title: Han Li Outsmarts a Mantis and Finds a Cultivator's Storage Pouch
og_description: Dead eggs, a mountain of insect feed, and one priceless jade slip. A classic RMJI loot chapter where victory isn’t always about treasure.
twitter_title: RMJI Chapter 348 – The Jade Slip That Changes Everything
twitter_description: Han Li’s quiet victory yields a strange insect manual and a hoarder’s trove. Sometimes the real loot is knowledge.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare insect demon beast ranked #73 in the cultivator's strange-insect hierarchy. Despite its name, its actual carapace is gray, creating an enduring naming puzzle for readers.
A legendary minor forbidden array that specializes in illusion and confusion; when fully deployed, it can trap and exhaust a high-grade demon beast before delivering the killing blow.
The reproductive product of high-grade demon beasts; often stillborn in xianxia, reinforcing the world's brutal scarcity logic—powerful life never comes cheap.
A jade information medium used by cultivators to store techniques, records, and knowledge; one good jade slip can be worth more than a pile of tools or treasures.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are all the mantis eggs dead?
cultural_notes_faq.a: High-grade demon beasts reproduce rarely, and stillbirth is common—it's a worldbuilding detail that reinforces the scarcity of powerful life in the cultivation world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What's so special about the jade slip?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It contains a ranking of strange insects (#1 to hundreds) plus breeding and control techniques, opening a new strategic subplot for Han Li's future.
